# The Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Phases & Roadmap
World of Warcraft Classic released its 20th Anniversary Edition on November 21, 2024. This started characters at the beginning of the Classic experience on fresh servers, which are now progressing into The Burning Crusade.

...

## TBC Classic Anniversary Servers
### TBC Classic Anniversary Server List
| Region | Name | Type |
| EU | Spineshatter | PvP |
| EU | Thunderstrike | PvE |
| NA | Nightslayer | PvP |
| NA | Dreamscythe | PvE |
| AU - NA | Maladath | PvP |
Hardcore Servers, Doomhowl (NA), and Soulseeker (EU) are confirmed to remain at WoW Classic. Players can choose to transfer to PvE should they wish to continue on to The Burning Crusade Classic.
